content:
Some record types in Tenable Web App Scanning support the use of an optional POST body that
controls filtering during record retrieval. Before you submit a request containing these parameters,
determine which parameters are available for a record type, which fields are available for filtering and
in what ways filters parameters can be applied.
Use the API to list available filters for scan configurations, user templates, asset workbench,
vulnerabilities workbench, scan history, and scan finding API operations.
